scope: The model-comparison runs use a temporary native Ollama instance under dgilmore on loopback port 11436. Separate dedicated_service_verification and restart_verification records cover subsequent requests under _moedollama on port 11437, including a restart and inference without desktop login. Synthetic page contexts only; no live MOED integration.
method: 12 sequential requests per model; think=false, temperature=0, seed=42, context=8192, output cap=512. Same revised prompt, fixtures, and runner for these two runs. Median uses all 12 requests; no concurrency or repeated-trial confidence estimate.
conclusion: Hardware supports usable local inference. Neither tested configuration is ready for an unsupervised in-app coach. Control and citation membership checks do not establish factual correctness; critical manual review failures remain.
